business_summary: Qingdao Hi-Tech Moulds & Plastics Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells automotive plastic injection tools in China. It offers automotive interior and exterior injection molds, including instrument panel molds, door panel molds, bumper molds, and grille molds; plastic parts such as automotive dashboards and door trim panels; and modified plastics, including modified polypropylene (PP), modified polystyrene (ABS), and engineering plastics, such as PA6, PA66, PC/ABS, PC/ASA alloy, ABS/PMMA alloy, and PEEK. The company also provides integrated molding solutions, encompassing mold design, manufacturing, debugging, plastic parts production, and modified plastics development, supporting one-stop procurement and molding integration. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
